about.lead: More than twenty years of global experience — woven into one cohesive practice that bridges mind, body and energy.
about.story_p1: For over two decades I have lived and worked as a coach, entrepreneur, consultant and humanitarian worker across the globe — on projects in psychosocial support, education, peacebuilding and conflict resolution.
about.story_p2: Originally from Italy, my anchor is now Beirut. Living here has taught me, in the most visceral way, that resilience isn't about being unbreakable — it's about the light that comes through the cracks. This is the core truth I bring into my work.
about.story_p3: My education reflects a global path: studies in Italy and the United Kingdom, professional certifications in the United States and Malaysia, and teachings drawn from Indian and Japanese wisdom traditions.
about.story_p4: This synthesis of **Western education and Eastern philosophy** forms the backbone of my integrative practice — a space where clients feel truly seen, safe, and empowered to embrace every part of their story, especially the fractured ones.
